scope: Evolution Phase One.5-C historical rollback disposition
source: Live supabase_migrations.schema_migrations ledger and exact 53-file active migration chain, read-only audit on 2026-11-18

entries.name: phase_0_security_performance
entries.reason: Changes policies, grants, function search paths and indexes; prior privilege/policy definitions are not embedded.

entries.name: phase_0_revoke_public_definer
entries.reason: Privilege revocation/grants have no captured pre-change ACL snapshot; broad reversal could expose privileged functions.

entries.name: weekly_tournament_cycles_and_matches
entries.reason: Creates/changes durable tournament tables and constraints; dropping them could destroy live match history.

entries.name: auto_seed_42_weekly_match_slots
entries.reason: Seeds rows and installs trigger/function behavior; seeded slots may now contain user-entered results.

entries.name: player_drill_assignments
entries.reason: Creates a durable assignment table and policies; live assignment records must be preserved.

entries.name: harden_assignments_and_sync_training_notes
entries.reason: Changes table shape, policies, grants, indexes and synchronization behavior; exact prior definitions are not retained.

entries.name: remove_overlapping_team_settings_policy
entries.reason: Removes an overlapping policy; restoring it without its exact predicate may widen team access.

entries.name: enable_realtime_for_squad_operations
entries.reason: Changes publication membership; prior publication membership snapshot is not stored in the migration.

entries.name: unique_squad_usernames
entries.reason: Adds uniqueness behavior; removing it could reintroduce duplicate identity labels and break dependent assumptions.

entries.name: team_avatars_and_optional_logo
entries.reason: Adds team fields and policy/data behavior; dropping fields can erase user-supplied avatar metadata.

entries.name: account_recovery_email_and_otp
entries.reason: Creates recovery/OTP storage and access controls; dropping it risks account recovery records and security boundaries.

entries.name: team_join_approval_and_role_assignments
entries.reason: Adds join/role schema, data and privileged RPC/policy behavior; prior function and ACL state is not captured.

entries.name: guard_fifth_slot_in_join_approval
entries.reason: Replaces join-approval logic and privileges; restoring an older guard could bypass roster-capacity checks.

entries.name: team_leave_and_empty_cleanup
entries.reason: Adds leave/cleanup behavior including row deletion; rollback cannot restore rows already removed by runtime cleanup.

entries.name: team_backup_export_restore
entries.reason: Adds backup/restore RPCs that replace team-owned rows; rollback cannot undo restore operations or recreate overwritten data.

entries.name: tighten_empty_team_cleanup_schedule
entries.reason: Changes scheduled cleanup logic that can delete team records; reversing code cannot restore deleted records.

entries.name: lock_cleanup_trigger_function
entries.reason: Changes function execution privileges; no exact prior ACL snapshot is retained.

entries.name: restrict_join_review_rpc_to_signed_in_users
entries.reason: Changes RPC grants; restoring public execution without a reviewed baseline would weaken access control.

entries.name: scope_player_igns_to_each_team
entries.reason: Changes schema/data and RPC behavior to team-scoped identity; reversing may merge or expose cross-team player records.

entries.name: scope_backup_restore_to_selected_team
entries.reason: Changes backup/restore RPC grants; prior ACL state is unavailable and broader grants are unsafe.

entries.name: scope_leave_action_to_selected_team
entries.reason: Changes leave RPC grants; automatic reversal could allow unscoped team-leave actions.

entries.name: remove_legacy_global_ign_check
entries.reason: Changes stored IGN validation behavior and data; old global uniqueness semantics are not safely restorable.

entries.name: disable_legacy_unscoped_team_admin_rpcs
entries.reason: Disables legacy unscoped admin RPC execution; re-enabling it would reopen an unsafe path.

entries.name: restore_owner_team_scoped_ign_from_backup
entries.reason: Changes backup restoration behavior; exact prior function body and safe data mapping are not preserved.

entries.name: phase_2_configurable_roster_capacity
entries.reason: Adds configurable capacity and updates data/function rules; reverting can invalidate teams already using custom capacity.

entries.name: phase_2_capacity_guard_member_assignment
entries.reason: Changes membership assignment guard and RPC privileges; old behavior could permit capacity bypass.

entries.name: fix_set_display_name_rpc_ambiguity
entries.reason: Replaces a public RPC implementation and grants; previous function body/ACL cannot be reconstructed safely from this migration alone.

entries.name: phase_2_3_planning_training
entries.reason: Creates Planning/Training tables, indexes and RLS; dropping tables would destroy user-created plans and training records.

entries.name: phase_2_3_player_task_updates
entries.reason: Changes task policies; restoring previous policies without exact predicate review could expose or block team data.

entries.name: phase_2_3_seed_drill_templates
entries.reason: Seeds/updates drill templates that may have been edited or referenced; do not delete or overwrite them automatically.

entries.name: phase_2_3_session_participants
entries.reason: Creates session-participant schema and RLS; live participant history and dependencies must remain intact.

entries.name: phase_2_3_tactical_plan_fields
entries.reason: Adds tactical-plan columns; dropping them could destroy saved tactical-plan content.

entries.name: phase_2_3_role_drill_templates
entries.reason: Seeds role-specific templates that may now be referenced or customized; preserve rows.

entries.name: phase_2_3_task_blocked_reason_and_category
entries.reason: Adds task metadata columns; dropping them could erase blocker reasons/categories.

entries.name: phase_2_3_followup_task_session_link
entries.reason: Adds a task/session relationship field; dropping it would lose follow-up linkage.

entries.name: expand_drill_library_to_50
entries.reason: Adds/updates drill catalogue rows; preserve catalogue IDs and any user references/customizations.

entries.name: role_specific_drill_progression
entries.reason: Adds/updates progression content; automatic deletion could break player progression references.

entries.name: complete_role_drill_library_to_100
entries.reason: Adds/updates drill records; preserve rows and references rather than deleting a historical seed batch.

entries.name: anonymous_daily_player_evaluation_feedback
entries.reason: Changes evaluation/feedback schema; rollback could expose or discard anonymous feedback data.

entries.name: enforce_daily_evaluation_date_and_anonymity
entries.reason: Replaces the date/anonymization trigger; reverting without exact prior function body could weaken anonymity/date enforcement.

entries.name: allow_anonymous_daily_evaluation_insert
entries.reason: Changes Daily Evaluation INSERT policy; restoring or removing it without policy review risks breaking privacy or access.

entries.name: daily_score_feedback_private_rls
entries.reason: Creates/changes feedback table, functions, policies and grants; exact prior state and private feedback data must be preserved.

entries.name: daily_score_feedback_private_rls
entries.reason: A second distinct live version with the same name; treat independently by version and preserve later privacy state.

entries.name: smart_task_deadlines_and_retention
entries.reason: Changes task schema, triggers, policies and cleanup/deletion behavior; deleted historical rows cannot be restored by code rollback.

entries.name: fix_task_lifecycle_event_order
entries.reason: Changes task lifecycle function/trigger and data ordering; old ordering may have already changed persisted event sequences.

entries.name: igl_task_management_rls
entries.reason: Changes IGL task policies; exact prior policy state must be reviewed before any reversal.

entries.name: retention_settings_owner_access
entries.reason: Changes owner access policy/grants; restoring prior access may expose retention settings to non-owners.

entries.name: team_scoped_retention_policies
entries.reason: Creates retention settings, policies and cleanup function that deletes data; deleted rows are not recoverable through rollback.

entries.name: seed_team_retention_on_team_create
entries.reason: Seeds per-team retention settings through trigger/function behavior; preserve customized team settings.

entries.name: scrims_personal_team_review
entries.reason: Creates Scrims review data structures and policies; dropping them would destroy private team review records.

entries.name: scrims_owner_update_team_scope
entries.reason: Changes owner update policy; automatic reversal could widen write access beyond the owning team.

entries.name: create_character_profiles_table
entries.reason: Creates the canonical profile table and public read policy; dropping it would remove the runtime catalogue mirror.

entries.name: sync_all_67_character_profiles
entries.reason: Upserts 67 profile records; preserve later corrections and edits instead of deleting or reverting catalogue rows.
